messages:
Emily (PM): quick sync — planning console observability for H2. Sales & a couple enterprise customers pushed for better cost breakdowns, traces, and error analytics. proposing a tight MVP scope so we can ship and iterate. thoughts?

Raj (Eng): +1. want to call out engineering constraints early: dashboard query latency for 24h windows needs to be <2s. also token-level granularity is expensive. can we approximate cost initially?

Sofia (Observability): customers repeatedly asked for: 1) cost by route/model, 2) latency percentiles, 3) error groups with example traces, 4) tracing hook to correlate app spans -> model spans. also would be great to surface cache-hit % (prefix/KV cache) since that directly affects cost.

Ben (Runtime): runtime can emit spans with attributes: request_id, model.name, model.variant, batch.size. sampling should be configurable; suggest default 1% sampling to keep storage low. token-level costing: we can estimate tokens * model_unit_cost and reconcile against billing later.

Lena (Design): I'll produce three mock cards: cost overview (top routes + est $), latency per model (p50/p95/p99), errors (top groups + sample traces). will include small callout for "estimated savings from cache". prototypes by Wed.

Emily (PM): proposed MVP scope (keep tight):
- Cost breakdown by route + model (estimated token cost)
- Latency histograms / p50,p95,p99 per route/model
- Error analytics: grouping + sample traces (via sampled spans)
- Tracing hooks + example middleware + docs
- Basic alerts surface (threshold alert for cost spike / error rate) as beta (not GA)
- Default retention 30d, enterprise opt-in 90d

Emily (PM): suggested exclusions for v1: live token-level drilldown, full-text trace search, and ad-hoc SQL-style explorer. defer to v2.

Raj (Eng): agreement + a couple notes:
- Need an hourly pre-aggregation job for cost by route/model to keep dashboard queries fast.
- API surface: GET /observability/cost?start=&end=&group_by=route,model
- Acceptance tests need synthetic traces to validate grouping and sampling.

Sofia (Observability): retention & sampling config options sound good. default sample 1%, add simple sampling override per-tenant. also: include cache_hit_pct and estimated_savings in cost response.

Ben (Runtime): ops note: we need to propagate request_id from API layer into runtime. simple required fields in traces:
```
trace.attributes: ["request_id", "model.name", "model.variant", "batch.size", "prefix_cache_hit"]
```
Make sure SDK docs show how to attach app span ids.

Lena (Design): UI AC (draft):
```
- Cost card shows top 10 routes (by $) and a breakdown by model variant
- Latency card shows p50/p95/p99, with timeseries for each metric
- Errors card lists grouped errors with count and link to 1-3 sampled traces
- All cards load under 2s for a 24h rolling window
```

Matt (Customer Success): FYI ACME expects alerting on cost spikes and error rate regressions. They asked for email + webhook. Can we include at least webhook in beta?

Emily (PM): add "alerts: webhook + email opt-in" to v1-beta backlog. not a GA blocker.

Raj (Eng): scope call: drop live token-level drilldown from v1 (agreed). Also recommend paginated APIs for traces and limit sample size to avoid blowups.

Ben (Runtime): I'll own the pre-agg job and runtime changes. plan to submit an RFC by Tue and a rough infra plan by Fri.

Lena (Design): mocks uploaded to figma: link https://figma.com/redwood/obs-mvp (private) — feedback welcome.

Emily (PM): launch criteria (draft) — please confirm:
- Dashboard: cost by route+model, latency p50/p95/p99, error groups with sample traces
- Tracing: request-level spans emitted with required attributes and doc examples
- Performance: dashboard queries <2s for 24h default window
- Retention: 30d default, opt-in 90d for enterprise
- Alerts: basic webhook/email for cost/error thresholds (beta)
- Docs: SDK examples + migration notes

Emily (PM): action items: @Lena (Design) mocks by Wed; @Ben (Runtime) pre-agg plan by Fri; @Raj (Eng) API surface + acceptance tests; @Sofia sampling + retention config; I'll publish roadmap doc and run a sync Thu 10:00am.

deploy-bot: CI: feature/obs-mvp built successfully — deploy queued to staging. :ship: (automated)

Emily (PM): thanks — keeping scope tight so we can iterate quickly. we'll review blockers in Thu sync. :thumbsup:
